payload.title: WorkspaceShell cross-platform (web/iOS/Android) + demo cutover
payload.description:
Implement the adaptive app shell from internal/specs/2026-05-10-frick-workspace-shell-design.md across all platforms; only stubs exist today.

- Web WorkspaceShell: responsive compact (bottom bar + drawers) vs desktop (app rail + sidebar + content + inspector), semantic destination/collection/content/inspector slots, a11y (spec:25-44, 56-75, 135-136). Stub at packages/design-web/src/components.tsx.
- SwiftUI FrickWorkspaceShell: TabView + .tabViewStyle(.sidebarAdaptable) + .inspector (NOT NavigationSplitView) (spec:25-29, 78-90, 140-142). Stub at packages/design-swift.
- Android FrickWorkspaceShell: Material 3 NavigationSuiteScaffold + adaptive panes — unbuilt (spec:31-35, 92-106, 148-151).
- Demo cutover: move the chat demo into a Chat destination; add Files/Calls/Admin placeholders (spec:111-132).

Size: M/L.
